## About

Opting out with `.nopanzoom` and `#| panzoom: false`, and the `hint` and
`max-zoom` options set on one cell. The page sets `loop`, so the gallery in
case 6 wraps around:

```yaml
panzoom:
  loop: true
```

There is no lightbox, so an image panzoom leaves alone opens nothing. The
`caption` and `description` options are on
[`g-captions`](g-captions.html), and `fit` is on [`h-wide`](h-wide.html).

The cases below draw with this helper:

```{r}
wave <- function(k = 1) {
  x <- seq(0, 4 * pi, length.out = 400)
  col <- hcl.colors(4, "Dark 3")[k]
  plot(x, sin(k * x), type = "n", main = paste("Wave", k), xlab = "x", ylab = "sin(kx)")
  polygon(c(x, rev(x)), c(sin(k * x), rep(0, length(x))), col = adjustcolor(col, 0.35), border = NA)
  lines(x, sin(k * x), lwd = 2, col = col)
}
```

## 1. `.nopanzoom` {#c1 expect-open="nothing panzoom"}

Two images in a `.panzoom` div, the first marked `.nopanzoom`. The first
opens nothing, since there is no lightbox on this page, and the second opens
in panzoom.

```{.markdown .show-source}
::: {.panzoom layout-ncol="2"}
![Opted out.](../../images/mv-1.jpg){.nopanzoom}

![Not opted out.](../../images/mv-2.jpg)
:::
```

## 2. `panzoom: false` in a div {#c2 expect-open="nothing"}

An R cell with `panzoom: false` in a `.panzoom` div. The whole cell opts
out, so clicking it does nothing.

::: {.panzoom}

```{r}
#| panzoom: false
#| fig-cap: "Opted out cell."

wave(k = 1)
```

:::

## 3. `hint: false` {#c3 expect-open="panzoom" expect-hint="hidden"}

A cell with `hint: false`. It opens in panzoom without the controls hint,
which the page shows by default.

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   hint: false

wave(k = 3)
```

## 4. Default hint {#c4 expect-open="panzoom" expect-hint="shown"}

A cell with no hint option. It opens in panzoom with the controls hint at
the bottom.

```{r}
#| panzoom: true

wave(k = 4)
```

## 5. `max-zoom: 2` {#c5 expect-open="panzoom" expect-max-zoom="2"}

A cell with `max-zoom: 2`. It opens in panzoom, and zooming in stops at 2
screen pixels per image pixel.

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   max-zoom: 2

wave(k = 1)
```

## 6. `loop: true` {#c6 expect-open="panzoom"}

Three plots in one gallery. With the page's `loop: true`, the left arrow key
on the first plot goes to the last, and the previous button is never
disabled.

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   group: waves
#| fig-cap:
#|   - "Wave one."
#|   - "Wave two."
#|   - "Wave three."

wave(k = 1)
wave(k = 2)
wave(k = 3)
```

## 7. No alt text {#c7 expect-open="panzoom" expect-caption="none"}

A marked image with no alt text. It opens in panzoom with no caption, and
the link around it is labeled "Open image" for screen readers.

```{.markdown .show-source}
![](../../images/mv-4.jpg){.panzoom width=40%}
```
